judgments.justification: “each of the three evaluated KD losses” covers displayed rows but omits the four additional paired losses reported in the table note.
“most individual datasets” understates the result: all 15 displayed loss-by-dataset comparisons improved, although the gains identify GKD as largest.
“outperformed the teacher on two of five datasets ... but not on the other three or on average” matches the table.
The passage does not state that full Method M was the highest-scoring KLD configuration on every evaluation set.
The performance of curriculum ordering alone, with both schedules removed, is not reported.
“supervised-ratio schedule is the main driver” reverses the ablation evidence and assigns the reported variant scores to the wrong removed schedules.
“No statistical tests or standard deviations” is correct, but the unstated training-run count and excluded analogous OPT table are omitted.
“each of the three evaluated KD losses” reports only displayed losses, omitting the same positive average direction for four additional paired losses.
“consistent on every individual dataset for each loss” covers all 15 comparisons, and the listed gains show GKD had the largest gain.
The strongest student's overall and dataset-level comparisons with the teacher are not reported.
“full Method M ... yields the highest scores on all five datasets” directly matches the ablation table.
“performs comparably ... on average” replaces the required per-set result: ordering alone was lower on four sets and only 0.09 higher on SelfInst.
“removing the ratio schedule ... reduces performance on four of five datasets” is wrong: it trails full Method M on all five.
“three KD losses ... tested” understates reported scope; standard deviations, independent-run information, descriptive seed means, and the omitted OPT table are unreported.
“each of the three evaluated KD losses” reports only displayed losses, omitting the same positive average direction for four additional paired losses.
“observed on every individual dataset for each loss” covers all 15 comparisons, and the listed gains establish GKD's largest average gain.
The passage does not compare the strongest displayed student with the teacher.
“full Method M ... yields the highest scores on all five datasets” accurately reports the ablation result.
“performs comparably ... on average” does not report the per-set pattern: four decreases and only a 0.09-point SelfInst increase.
“removing the ratio schedule ... reduces performance on all five” captures its contribution but omits the evidence identifying rising temperature as the main driver.
“three KD losses ... tested” understates reported scope and omits standard deviations, independent-run information, descriptive seed means, and the excluded OPT table.
